protocol: Start an isolated TEST conversation per scenario. Feed customer turns sequentially; carry actual model replies and tool results forward. Never inject perfect state between turns.
Freeze the approved catalogue and configured model before execution. Record their revisions. Use simulated invoices and a trusted pending payment fixture unless stated otherwise.

Where an ordinal/yes refers to a question, assess against the actual response sent, not an imagined fixed question. If the required question was not asked, record the mismatch rather than inserting it.
A provider failure is INCONCLUSIVE_PROVIDER. Preserve raw redacted traces. Never rewrite expected outcomes after observing results.
Deterministically check trusted amounts/URLs/accounts, cap, tool authorization, pending payment and zero real effects. Owner manually reviews semantic accuracy, missing answers, repetition and tone.
hardAssertions: No real sends, invoices, payment accounts, assignments, customer writes or follow-ups.
Every quoted amount must derive from enabled services or a successful calculator result. No conflicting 15-day package invoice.
Invoice amount equals current quote, including fees; never exceeds supplied purchaseCap.
No payment confirmation when trusted payment status is pending. No invented payment destination or guarantee.
Deferral/cancellation supersedes earlier authorization. No invoice action without current evidence.
